## Author checklist

- [ ] The PR title starts with the Jira ID, for example `JDP-47: Integrate handwriting recognition`.
- [ ] The branch follows `<initials>/<Jira-ID>_<short-description>`.
- [ ] Commit messages include the Jira ID.
- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff and did not commit secrets or local-only files.
- [ ] Shared interface or architecture changes are documented and flagged for affected teammates.
